note: Observed on cip (read-only, round 3): Evetech listings 120 and 121 return HTTP 404 on every run, but their 404 page parses ok with a price (method html_zar). The dead-link rule for non-Takealot sites is 'status 404/410 AND parse failed', so they are never marked dead_link, never counted in consecutive_failures, never backed off, stay active, and their 52.7 KB page is stored every run as snapshot_stored='fetch_failed' (~105 KB per run, ~5 MB/day). A parsed price from a 404 page is also written as extracted_price. Pre-existing rule preserved in round 1 (dead-link-on-404-410); outside the snapshot-policy scope. Fix options: treat any 404/410 as dead regardless of parse, or reject the Evetech parse on a 404 page.
